family.description: T3SS_needle_E is a family of proteins from the operon that builds and controls the needle of the injection system of type III secretion. The YscE protein, produced by the pathogen Yersinia, assumes a secondary structure composed of two anti-parallel alpha-helices separated by a flexible loop [[cite:PUB00049490]]. The family is cytoplasmic and may help to stabilise and prevent early polymerisation of the needle-protein F [[cite:PUB00048615],[cite:PUB00109133]].
family.name: Type III secretion system, cytoplasmic E component of needle
